why: Ingestion for a customer is three OCI artifacts that cross three repositories and two
GCP projects. igniteiq-depot BUILDS and PUBLISHES them; igniteiq-platform COPIES them
into the customer's project via the connector-push callback; igniteiq-deploy is the
Terraform the CUSTOMER runs, and it expects them to already be there under exact names.
Nobody owns the whole path. Each repo holds its third of the coordinates as a literal,
and a mismatch does not fail at build, review or plan time -- it fails during a new
customer's onboarding, in their project, where we cannot reproduce it. This file is the
agreed set of names, and each side checks its own literals against it.
It deliberately does NOT own versions that legitimately move (the chart version, the
connector version). Those are read from their source of truth by the depot-side check.
What it owns is the NAMES, because a name is what silently stops matching.

source._: IgniteIQ's own registries. Platform copies FROM here.

_: The customer's own project. Note the ASYMMETRY, which is the least obvious thing here:
on our side the image and the chart live in TWO repositories (depot-connectors and
depot-charts); in the customer's project they ride ONE (depot-connectors). So the
connector-push callback is a two-source-to-one-target copy, and 'the chart repo' means
different things on either side of it.
The manifest slug and the IMAGE NAME are deliberately different and both are correct.
Airbyte convention prefixes a source definition with 'source-'; the image is published
without it. Do not 'fix' either to match the other -- that is a rename in a customer's
registry, and dockerRepository is not updatable on an existing definition.

why: Tapps' source definition was registered against a repository that has since been
retired, and BOTH the repo and the image name differ from every other tenant.
dockerRepository is accepted on a definition update and SILENTLY IGNORED, so the
definition can only ever pull from the repo it is already on.
Every release must therefore be MIRRORED there with
igniteiq-depot/scripts/copy_image_cross_repo.py. connector-release-sync cannot do it
because that job copies into CUSTOMER projects, and this repo is one of ours.
Tapps is the FORGE_TEMPLATE_JOB tenant, so a release missed here propagates to every
new customer. Recorded as an exception rather than cleaned up because the cleanup is
a re-registration. Durable fix = ENG-285.
